results.title: Reliance plans $1.6 billion investment in 100 compressed biogas plants by 2030
results.content: The company aims to produce five million cubic metres of biogas daily using agricultural residue, as India seeks to increase gas’s share in its energy mix

results.title: India vs New Zealand Test series: India faces test of character as WTC hopes hang in balance
results.content: Live from a windy Basin Reserve in Wellington, The Hindu and Sportstar preview the crucial India vs New Zealand Test series. With India’s World Test Championship (WTC) final hopes hanging in the balance—requiring at least six wins from their remaining seven Tests—captain Shubman Gill and head coach Gautam Gambhir face a major selection dilemma on a lush green pitch. In this on-ground report, The Hindu’s Amol Karhadkar break down India’s strategy.

results.content: Significant increase in horticultural production reflects the hard work of India’s farmers and the impact of the Centre’s farmer-friendly policies, Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan says

results.title: IPL 2027 retention highlights: Dhoni retires, teams announce lists of released and retained players as deadline ends
results.content: Four trades involving 10 players across six franchises have been confirmed ahead of the IPL 2027 retention deadline, with Mumbai Indians’ Hardik Pandya moving to Punjab Kings and Rishabh Pant returning to Delhi Capitals

results.title: INS Sahyadri participates in India-Japan naval exercise JAIMEX 2026
results.content: According to the Indian Navy, during the exercise, INS Sahyadri operated alongside JMSDF ship JS Ise, undertaking a series of coordinated maritime engagements, including tactical manoeuvres, communication drills, and cross-deck landings
